routing_judgement.cohort_ranking_to_slm_toolcall_not_evalu: The brief routes 'scoring and ranking outputs' to evaluations-v1, but the cohort's own scoring artifacts were already placed in slm-toolcall-v1/scoring/ by the first pass. Putting the cohort ranking in evaluations-v1 would split one cohort result across two repositories and break that precedent, so cohort-rank/out/ went to slm-toolcall-v1/ranking/. evaluations-v1 holds System One board evaluations; the cohort is a separate programme.
routing_judgement.reshard_and_supervisor_to_predictions: Neither is rows, predictions, scoring nor ranking. reshard/ is the provenance of a prediction body and supervisor/ is the operational record of the runs that produced them, so both were co-located with the artifacts they attest in predictions-v1. The brief's own reason - 'the chunk plan is what makes the merge auditable' - argues for keeping plan and artifact in one repository.

card_corrections.what: slm-toolcall-v1: corrected the trivial-floor count from 8 of 19 to 9 of 19.
card_corrections.why: Recomputed from ranking/ranking-analysis.json against the s2 block-only floor 0.20503174229955326. Nine candidates sit at or below it at their shipped point (olmo-2-1b-instruct, smollm3-3b, prompt-guard-2-22m, prompt-guard-2-86m, granite-guardian-3.1-2b all exactly 0.0; llama-guard-3-1b, shieldstral-1.0-3b, shieldgemma-2b, falcon3-3b-instruct below it). The brief and the earlier caveat both said 8.

56.75% (17202 of 30310) is the runner's *shrunk* count - rows whose context was repeatedly cut to 82% and re-rendered to fit the 510-token cap, so they lost context the model never saw. The row-level `truncated` boolean is true for only 6.88% (2086 rows) and means something different. A reader checking the wrong field would have concluded the card was wrong.

card_corrections.what: slm-toolcall-v1: recorded that the length cue is corpus-specific.
card_corrections.why: ~0.77 AUC on s2 (event count 0.7772553177633239, prompt tokens 0.7692264380822134) but chance on s3 (context_bytes 0.504185543681342, context_events 0.34604723008084354). Length-controlled AUC is the right s2 ranking metric; an s2->s3 drop partly reflects the cue leaving with the corpus.
